verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own documented feature lets users turn a SQL query into a monitored rule with an operator, threshold, interval and severity, and attach reusable Slack or HTTP webhook destinations to it. That is a real rule-to-action automation, but it is interval-polled threshold alerting whose only documented actions are notifications and webhooks, not general event-driven actions. Missing for 10: true event-based triggers (beyond interval polling of a query), action types beyond notifications/webhooks, rule-engine depth or chaining, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Turn any SQL query against your cluster into a monitored rule: set an operator, threshold, interval, and severity, start from a template
Organization-scoped, reusable Slack and HTTP webhook destinations you set up once and attach to any rule.
